1. Name: Brilliant Nodes.
2. Networks and AuM: we run a Gnosis Chain mainnet full node, an Ethereum Hoodi testnet node (Lido CSM testnet operator in setup), this gno.land Onyx node, and seed and pool infrastructure for new proof-of-work networks, on servers in Europe, the US and Asia. AuM: no delegated stake today.
3. Links: https://brilliantnodes.com | status: https://brilliantnodes.github.io/status | X: @brilliantnodes | GitHub: https://github.com/brilliantnodes | Discord: brilliantnodes
4. Contact: bn@brilliantnodes.com
5. Why gno.land: proof-of-contribution and fully readable on-chain code. We want to earn a place by running reliable infrastructure from Onyx through to mainnet.
6. Contributions: we run every Onyx release candidate ahead of mainnet (v1.8.0-rc.1 since the 1,203,400 halt, checksum-verified) and report issues; we keep public uptime monitoring; we will open-source our operator tooling (automatic version switching at upgrade halt heights, monitoring and alerts) and write operator documentation.
